messages:
olivia: Heads-up — Large EU financial prospect (RegBank) wants a compact package for vendor risk: 1) a CSV of subprocessors by country/function, 2) a one-page data flow diagram (ingress -> processing -> logs -> backups), 3) explicit statement whether any backups or logs for this tenant are allowed to live in the US, and 4) KMS/HSM key handling details. They need it by Friday COB. Can we deliver?

marc: Yes. Proposed split: Mike exports raw subprocessor rows + infra region tags, Ill make the customer-facing CSV and the DFD, Ananya drafts the security attestation + CAIQ snippets, Jess to confirm runtime KMS/replication behavior.

olivia: They also asked for a signed subprocessor addendum tied to our DPA if we can provide it. They're clear: regulated backups must not be stored in the US.

ananya: Security notes: hosted-global tenants may have some operational backups/metrics replicated outside EU by default. We can produce a redacted subprocessor list and a controls excerpt (CAIQ) with references to data residency and key mgmt. Full vendor contracts need Legal. I'll prepare an attestation draft that explains current behavior + mitigation paths.

jess: Implementation details: default hosted-global flow = API fronting in EU -> inference in EU region -> logs/metrics streamed to observability (EU primary, US secondary for resilience) -> long-term backups may replicate to secondary region (often US) unless tenant opt-in for EU-only. Dedicated/Private can be EU-only with customer-managed KMS/HSM.

mike: I'll run the export tomorrow morning and include columns: subprocessor_name,region,country,function,data_types,contract_status,notes. Ill link the raw export to the internal drive for review.

mike: Quick topology ascii for the DFD draft:

Client (EU) --> TLS --> Redwood Edge (eu-west) --> Router (eu) --> Inference Pool (eu-gpu)
                                                 \--> Logging agent --> Observability (eu-primary, us-replica)
                                                 \--> Backups --> Long-term storage (eu-primary, us-replica)
